name: app-and-report-with-ai
description: Two products and one modelling language. This manifest covers only the root-level language folder; each subfolder has its own.

scripts.check: bun run check:models && bun run type-check && bun run lint && bun run check:language-tools && bun run check:stacks && bun run check:clis && bun run check:pack
scripts._comment:clis: Two CLIs, two toolchains: `appwithai` is the TypeScript pipeline run by bun, `appwithai-gen` the Rust generator run by cargo. `check:clis` runs both, which needs cargo on PATH; CI gives the Rust one its own job with a Rust toolchain — see .github/workflows/root-ci.yml.
scripts.lint: bun run lint:language && bun run lint:scripts
scripts.lint:fix: bun run lint:language:fix && bun run lint:scripts:fix
scripts._comment:lint: language/biome.json is the config, and it is inside language/ rather than at the repository root because a root config makes both subfolders' own configs nested roots and Biome then refuses to run at all. Linting language/ means running from inside it; linting scripts/ means pointing --config-path at it from outside. Passing both at once makes Biome find that same file twice and fail.
scripts._comment:language-tools: html/checker.js and html/fixer.js are bundled from language/browser/*.entry.ts, and each one inlines language/appwithai-language.json. Editing the definition or the checker stales them, and nothing else notices — so `--check` runs in `check` and fails rather than serving a validator that disagrees with this repository's own language. website/viewers/eml-model.js is NOT built here: it is vendored from app-with-ai-tanstack's published viewers, which this repository no longer checks out.
